body: We Cut a Window Through Solid Brick - Basement Kitchen Before & After - The Bountiful Pool House.mp4, 1280x720, 30 fps, scaled to 1080p on splice

lines.vo: This basement kitchen was so cold they left the cupboards open all winter, so we gutted it.

shots.notes: sink corner with the cupboards hanging open, against the new sink under the new window
family room with track lights, against the finished family room

lines.vo: We cut a new window through solid brick and raised the kitchen ceiling.

shots.notes: the pile of cut brick under the new opening, against the trimmed window in the brick
kitchen wide under the raised ceiling and can lights

lines.vo: Stick around, and I'll tell you what it cost and how long it took.

shots.notes: Mike behind the island in the finished kitchen, arms open
finished family room under the tease card
